exposure: Multidisciplinary, team-based approach to cesarean hysterectomy
Time period (before and after protocol implementation)
multidisciplinary, team-based approach to management of cesarean hysterectomy
cohort: 107 women who underwent cesarean hysterectomy at a single institution in the USA
finding: Implementation of a multidisciplinary team-based approach to cesarean hysterectomy was associated with fewer days in surgical intensive care and lower frequency of postoperative febrile morbidity.
